name: Tsuma, Riko. Hajimete no Happening Bar Taiken
original_name: 妻、理子。はじめてのハプニングバー体験
source:
The story of Riko's seduction by her not-husband Ikefuchi. 
Ikebuchi was a cad at the bar. But his brazen conquests went further than imagined. 
He enjoyed doing wives. At this bar such arrangements were easy. 
Riko is and has always been a loving wife... 
... with a loving husband, who brought her here, obsessed with a recent fantasy. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE190153.html]Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
莉子被她的非丈夫池渊引诱的故事。
池渕是酒吧里的一个无赖。但他厚颜无耻的征服远超乎想象。
他喜欢做妻子。在这个酒吧，这样的安排很容易。
Riko一直都是一位慈爱的妻子…… 
……有一个充满爱心的丈夫，他把她带到这里，沉迷于最近的幻想。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE190153.html]Dlsite English[/url]]
